lines: Day eleven. One hundred and nine men fell.
open
And every bed in both hospitals is taken.
hosp
Thirty-four men wait on stretchers outside the door. The Hegemony medics reach only seven of every ten wounded.
hosp2
In cold, wet, crowded trenches, the next enemy is not a bullet. It is sickness.
sick
The front needs medics. New soldiers, comment Hegemony medic, or Concord medic.
medic
Rafael Ali died before the medic came. His squad kept his place on the fire step empty.
ali
Today his heir, Karel Ali, took that place. As a medic.
ali2
Hugo Kitty was killed passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence.
kitty
Grey Mill is close. Hegemony two hundred and nine, Concord one hundred and eighty-five, of three hundred.
mill
Whoever takes it gets a heavy howitzer, for good. It fires every day on the most crowded enemy trench, until it is destroyed.
gun
Every army needs a voice. Konrad Sebs for the Hegemony. Bastian Wizzerd for the Concord.
voice
Walter, Anselm, Quentin, Zeno and Lucien bought War Bonds. The front thanks you.
bonds
Six hundred and fifteen soldiers joined yesterday. And the Concord passed one thousand.
big
One thousand eight hundred and seventeen now hold the line. Hegemony eight hundred and seventeen. Concord, one thousand.
army
